title: Migrate admin bearer tokens to secretx URIs
description: Why: Transit AdminConfig.bearer_token (crates/transit/src/config.rs:239) and reader AdminConfig.admin_token (crates/reader/src/config.rs:396) are Option<String> values read directly from TOML. Putting the raw admin token in the config file is a common secret-in-config antipattern. Accepting a secretx: URI lets operators source the token from env, a secrets manager, or a file outside the config directory. What to do: After config load in each binary's main.rs/admin.rs startup path, check if the token value starts with 'secretx:' and if so resolve it via secretx::from_uri().get().await. The resolved bytes become the token used for ConstantTimeEq comparison in the admin server. No change to the AdminConfig struct or the comparison logic itself.
notes: Part of epic stoa-6c0f1855 (Integrate crate-secretsx). Blocked on stoa-f0b9ff15 (workspace wiring).
